title: Facebook co-founder Dustin Moskovitz says the ‘top job’ is not for him
content: Dustin Moskovitz co-founded Facebook and later started Asana, where he served as CEO for over a decade. Despite his achievements, he admitted that managing teams was not his true calling. Moskovitz faced increasing challenges during his tenure due to external social and political upheaval. Many corporate leaders, like Moskovitz, find themselves in management roles without formal training or desire. This phenomenon of the 'accidental manager' has become common in workplaces.

title: Flavio Bolsonaro flees to US after election defeat, vows to challenge Lula's victory
content: Flavio has yet to formally concede defeat, saying he would seek to annul the election result over alleged voter irregularities. His Liberal Party, however, acknowledged Lula's victory on Monday. Lula secured more than 64 million votes, defeating Bolsonaro, who received just under 60 million, by nearly 4.4 million votes. The incumbent is expected to take office on January 5, 2027, for a fourth non-consecutive term.

title: Meet Kayley Xu: San Diego student wins $25,000 for wearable stethoscope idea
content: Kayley Xu, a Year 12 student, developed Aucura, a wearable stethoscope designed to enhance respiratory diagnostics and access. After recovering from pneumonia, she sought to improve traditional stethoscopes that have changed little over time. Xu overcame challenges by creating a model of the human torso to test her device effectively. Her design aims to be affordable for clinics in rural and underfunded areas, allowing better access to medical technology.

title: US midterms: Is Trump about to lose control of Congress? What betting markets say
content: Ahead of the November 3 US midterms, betting markets suggest Trump's Republicans could lose control of Congress, with Democrats favoured to win the House and Senate. The odds also point to a difficult contest for Vivek Ramaswamy in Ohio.

title: Colin Farrell's foundation selects 16 charities for grants up to $50,000
content: With a commitment to enhancing the lives of individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities, the Colin Farrell Foundation has launched multiple grant initiatives across the country. By selecting 16 key organizations, the foundation focuses on fostering improved housing and employment options. These initiatives are crafted to enhance community engagement and address essential service gaps as young adults transition to independent living, creating a strong support system for their families.

title: Elon Musk’s six-word reply to Verizon CEO who said SpaceX needs 8 years to take it on
content: Verizon CEO Dan Schulman says SpaceX would need up to $500 billion, 80,000 cell towers and as long as eight years to build a US mobile network that rivals Verizon. Elon Musk hit back on X, saying it "will take 2 or 3 years". SpaceX plans to switch on Starlink Mobile in early 2028 after buying low-band mobile spectrum worth about $8 billion this month.

title: California couple's Halloween home show uses 28 computers, singing pumpkins
content: Every year, Jeff and Ann Haberman delight Long Beach with their spectacular Halloween display, enchanting families with synchronized lights, music, and lively animations. The elaborate setup is managed by 28 computers, enhancing the overall experience through striking visual effects and projections. Upholding their festive tradition, they will launch a Christmas display on December 1, while also contributing to children's mental health services through their fundraising initiatives.

title: Novak Djokovic’s $10M Marbella mansion: Inside his luxury home and family life
content: Novak Djokovic’s estimated $10 million Marbella mansion combines Moroccan-inspired design, family living and facilities suited to a professional tennis player. The nine-bedroom villa in Sierra Blanca includes a private court, gym, spa, swimming pool and cinema room. Alongside his wife Jelena and their children, Djokovic has built a life across international locations, with reported homes and property interests in Europe and the United States.

title: Michael Olise’s parents: Who are Vincent and Mina Olise?
content: Michael Olise's decision to represent France at the 2026 FIFA World Cup is rooted in family as much as football. His father, Vincent, played cricket for Nigeria across nearly a decade and passed on a love of sport beyond the game. His mother, Mina, a French woman of Algerian descent, introduced Michael to chess and shaped his connection to France from childhood. Together, the two parents built a household where four nationalities, two languages, and multiple sports coexisted, producing a player who carries all of it with him.

title: India exported over $850m worth of arms to Europe since start of Ukraine-Russia war
content: Amid the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict, India's defence sector is witnessing an impressive surge in ammunition exports to Europe. With military demands on the rise, India has emerged as a key supplier, achieving record export levels. This growth highlights not only India's manufacturing strengths but also its expanding international partnerships. European countries are eager to restock their military supplies, which bodes well for the future of India's defence industry.

title: Plan for bigger, heavier, stealthy next-generation destroyers gets defence council’s approval
content: The Defence Acquisition Council has greenlit the ambitious Project 18A aimed at developing next-generation destroyers for the Indian Navy. These innovative vessels promise to surpass current models in size and technological sophistication, with advanced armaments. The project, projected to cost over Rs 75,000 crore, envisions delivery timelines of 5 to 10 years post-contract.

title: Salim Merchant buys commercial property in Mumbai’s Santacruz West for Rs 12.85 crore
content: In a notable real estate deal, composer Salim Merchant, along with four investors, secured a commercial property in Santacruz, Mumbai, for Rs 12.85 crore. The property boasts spacious ground and first floors in a well-known building close to Linking Road. Completed on October 7, 2026, the transaction included a stamp duty of Rs 77.10 lakh. Read on to know more in detail.

title: 13-goal blitz! India show no mercy as Mandeep runs riot at ACT hockey tournament
content: India began their Asian Champions Trophy title defence with a crushing 13-0 victory over Bangladesh. Mandeep Singh scored a hat-trick, while Harmanpreet Singh, Dilpreet Singh and Hardik Singh netted twice each. India dominated from start to finish, leading 6-0 at half-time. The defending champions will next face China on Thursday, while Bangladesh prepare to take on Malaysia.

title: Mumbai airport switches to manual processing after network glitch, flight ops unaffected
content: On Tuesday evening, Mumbai airport experienced a network disruption that lasted for approximately one hour. As a result, airport teams had to switch to manual processing for check-in and boarding. This manual processing aimed to minimize inconvenience to passengers during the disruption. Mumbai International Airport Ltd confirmed that flight operations remained unaffected throughout this period. The cause of the network issue was not disclosed by airport officials.

title: Israel elections: Netanyahu makes emergency call to voters, warns of high Arab turnout
content: Israelis are casting their votes in a crucial parliamentary election, testing the stability of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's administration. Impressively, voter turnout is the highest recorded at this stage since 1996, showcasing a keen interest among the populace. Gadi Eisenkot, leading the opposition, warns of potential ballot tampering that could affect electoral fairness.

title: Badoni joins Kohli, Gambhir in elite list with back-to-back double tons
content: In a remarkable display of skill, Ayush Badoni secured his second consecutive double century, remaining unbeaten at 210 in the Ranji Trophy against Jharkhand. Following his earlier 217 against Gujarat, he, along with Sumit Mathur, created a formidable partnership of 334 runs. With Delhi declaring at 515, they hold a significant advantage, while Jharkhand struggles on Day 2, finishing at 131 for four amidst a daunting deficit.

title: 'I apologize to everyone': Mbappé reacts to 'Chinese dictator' controversy
content: Kylian Mbappé apologised after comments about a meme depicting Chinese leader Mao Zedong triggered backlash in China. Beverage maker Dongpeng, dairy giant Mengniu and cheese producer Milkground ended their partnerships with the French footballer. China's Foreign Ministry criticised the remarks, while social media platform RedNote removed promotional material. Online criticism intensified, with boycott-related hashtags trending on Weibo.

title: Is Jagan Reddy's 'regret' message a calculated alliance pitch for Congress?
content: YSRCP leader YS Jagan Mohan Reddy has publicly acknowledged his mistake of backing the BJP-led NDA government's law to appoint the CEC. Jagan, who was decimated in the 2024 assembly elections, is gearing up to navigate the complicated political landscape as the 2029 elections approach. Speculation abounds regarding a possible alliance with the Congress, creating formidable challenges, especially given the BJP's strong ties with Chandrababu Naidu.

title: Georgia man gets 15 years for $76m Ponzi scheme targeting 300 investors
content: Edwin Brant Frost IV, a businessman from Georgia, has received a 15-year prison sentence following his involvement in a Ponzi scheme that deceived more than 300 investors. This fraudulent operation caused a staggering loss of $76 million. Presenting himself as a reliable lender, Frost was actually battling significant financial turmoil. He misappropriated investors' money for his lavish lifestyle and political donations while neglecting loan repayments.

title: 'It was just me and Sooryavanshi': Abhishek after his record-breaking innings
content: Abhishek Sharma credited preparation and a clear game plan for his stunning 113 off 38 balls against New Zealand, saying he had “manifested” the innings. His partnership with Vaibhav Sooryavanshi produced a record 118-run powerplay, powering India to a six-wicket victory. Mentor Yuvraj Singh playfully challenged him to break his 12-ball T20I fifty record, while praising Abhishek’s explosive performance.

title: Watch: Houthis release dramatic drone strike footage from Saudi border regions
content: Recent footage unveiled by the Iran-aligned Houthis purports to showcase attacks on Saudi military sites at the borders. The group asserts it has specifically targeted Saudi forces in regions such as Najran, Jizan, and Asir, heightening regional tensions. Statements pointed to strikes on military transport planes and potential assaults on the Saudi defense ministry, intensifying security worries concerning the kingdom's military and crucial energy resources.

title: MIT students turn lunar waste into tools, win $925,000 in NASA competition
content: MIT students have pioneered a revolutionary recycling solution aimed at mitigating waste buildup on the Moon. As new supplies begin to arrive, it is vital to have efficient methods for dealing with packaging waste. This ambitious project, which has garnered accolades from NASA, seeks to transform waste into useful materials for lunar bases, setting a precedent for potential sustainability improvements both on the Moon and Earth.

title: California court upholds order to remove 19 trees after $78,500 settlement
content: In a protracted legal battle between neighboring homeowners in California, the Fourth District Court has decided that the invasive roots of 19 ficus trees must be completely removed. Although a prior financial settlement provided some relief, the roots continued to cause damage, prompting the affected homeowner to seek a more lasting remedy. The court ruled that total removal of the trees was essential to eliminate the persistent nuisance.

title: Abhishek, Sooryavanshi set new world record in India's 3rd T20I
content: Abhishek Sharma and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi set a new T20I record for the highest run rate in a 100-plus opening stand, scoring at 18.13 runs per over against New Zealand. Abhishek smashed 113 off 38 balls, while 15-year-old Sooryavanshi made 45 off 18. Their 133-run stand powered India to a six-wicket win and an unassailable 3-0 series lead.

title: DJ Moore’s $5M mansion: Inside the 10,000-square-foot home listed after trade
content: DJ Moore’s North Carolina mansion remains unsold after several adjustments to its asking price. The Buffalo Bills wide receiver listed the waterfront property after being traded from the Chicago Bears to the Bills. The Charlotte estate boasts three levels of living space with several amenities like swimming pool, theater, gym, private balcony, and screened-in porch.

title: Connor Hellebuyck trade: How silence may have shaped the surprising deal
content: The departure of Connor Hellebuyck from the Winnipeg Jets stemmed from multiple pressures, notably concerns over salary and the potential for public conflict. In an effort to prevent any escalation, the team prioritized a trade, aiming for a swift resolution in consultation with team leaders. Internal tensions within the locker room further pushed management to act decisively, allowing the organization to redirect its focus to hockey without further distractions.

title: Man loses testicle after vasectomy; court upholds $9.5m malpractice verdict
content: A Pennsylvania appeals court confirmed a substantial medical malpractice judgment against Dr. Jason A. Smith following a vasectomy gone wrong. Matthew Brennen, the patient, experienced severe complications that resulted in the removal of his testicle. The jury awarded $9.5 million in damages, recognizing the pain and loss suffered by both Matthew and his wife, Lisa. The defense's arguments regarding testicular torsion were refuted by expert testimony during the trial.

title: Waited 3 months for silver Royal Enfield, got blue; dealer ordered to pay Rs 28,000
content: A Kerala consumer commission has taken a firm stand against a Royal Enfield dealer for unfair practices following a delayed motorcycle delivery. After an arduous wait of three months, the buyer received a different colored model, compounded by issues reported upon pickup. The ruling mandated the dealer to compensate the complainant with Rs 25,000 plus legal fees, with a strict 30-day timeline for compliance to avoid accruing additional interest.
